note: Iteration 4 - one eval exercising api_rules via manage_collection. Write eval on a fresh mcpskill_rules collection; drop it after.

evals.name: api-rules-public-read-owner-write
evals.prompt: In our PocketBase create a base collection called 'mcpskill_rules' with these fields: owner (a required relation to the players collection), title (text, required), and secret (text). Set the access rules so that: anyone can list and view records; only a logged-in user can create; and only the record's owner can update or delete it. When you're done, show me the exact rules you set.
assertions: Creates collection 'mcpskill_rules' via manage_collection with fields owner (relation to players, required), title (text, required), and secret (text)
Sets the list and view rules to "" (empty string = fully public), NOT null and NOT a non-empty expression
Sets the create rule to an 'any authenticated user' expression such as @request.auth.id != "" (not "" and not null)
Sets both the update and delete rules to an owner check, i.e. owner = @request.auth.id
After the run, describe_collection('mcpskill_rules') shows api_rules where list and view are "", create requires auth, and update/delete are owner-scoped
Reports the five rule values it set back to the user
